groups.defect: The migration dereferences an empty category lookup result, raising before the uncategorized fallback can run.
groups.rationale: All three report the same unchecked execute(...)[0]['id'] access and the same failure when the join returns no rows.

groups.defect: The host lookup lowercases the database column but leaves the input hostname unchanged, causing mixed-case lookups to fail.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same asymmetric normalization in record_for_host and propose normalizing the lookup value.

groups.defect: The host normalization callback calls sub! on nil before validation can reject the missing host.
groups.rationale: These describe the same unguarded callback, request trigger, and resulting exception.

groups.defect: The category and embeddable-host fabricator definitions are placed in each other's files.
groups.rationale: Both report the same swapped contents, pointing at opposite files. The correction requires restoring the definitions in both files.

groups.defect: The blank-host test no longer exercises its named condition and instead passes because the topic has no embed.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same obsolete test case and its mismatch with the remaining implementation; the coverage and naming concerns describe the same test defect.

groups.defect: Both update and destroy dereference missing host records, returning exceptions for unknown or deleted IDs.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions report the identical pair of unchecked lookups. The merged comment must retain the need to handle missing records in both actions.
